vrrp_instance_name.description: Name of the VRRP instance (e.g., VI_1, ETH0_VRRP).

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0, ens33).

vrid.description: Virtual Router ID (1–255); must be unique per LAN segment.

priority.description: Priority (higher = more preferred); MASTER usually has highest.

advert_int.description: Advertisement interval in seconds (VRRP heartbeat frequency).

authentication.description: Optional VRRP authentication block (simple or password auth).

pass.description: Password for PASS auth (max 8 chars); empty disables auth block.

virtual_ipaddress.description: List of VIPs (IPv4 or IPv6) assigned to the instance (e.g., ['192.168.1.100/24', 'fd2001:db8::1/64']).

virtual_ipaddress_dev.description: List of VIPs excluded from kernel routes (used with notify scripts, e.g., ['10.0.0.100/32 dev eth0 scope host']).

preempt_delay.description: Seconds to delay preemption after startup (0 = no delay).

notify_script.description: Path to script run on state transition (takes role, priority, state as args).

garp_master_delay.description: Seconds to delay sending GARP (Gratuitous ARP) after becoming MASTER.

garp_master_refresh.description: Interval (seconds) to re-send GARP after MASTER transition (0 = disabled).

virtual_server.description: List of virtual servers (LVS NAT/DR/TUN mode load-balancing configs).

delay_loop.description: Interval (seconds) between health checks for real servers.

lb_algo.description: Load balancing algorithm (e.g., rr = round robin).

protocol.description: Protocol to balance (defaults to TCP if omitted).

persistence.description: Persistence timeout in seconds (0 = no persistence).

sorry_server.description: Fallback real server used when all real servers are down.

real_server.description: List of real servers backing the virtual server.

notify_up.description: Command/script to run when this real server becomes healthy.

notify_down.description: Command/script to run when this real server becomes unhealthy.

HTTP_GET.description: HTTP health check method (one of multiple check types).

status_code.description: Expected HTTP status code (optional; defaults to 200).

connect_timeout.description: TCP connect timeout (seconds) per health check.

retry.description: Number of retries on failed checks before marking down.

TCP_CHECK.description: TCP connect-only health check (simple alternative to HTTP_GET).

port.description: Port to connect to (defaults to real_server port if omitted).
